context: An office manager helps a barista friend pick a rental apartment
purpose: Teach: 住まい/居住/アパート/軒/一層/売却/下落/売ら

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新しい住まい探し、進んでる？候補は絞れた？
lines.en: How's the new apartment search going? Have you narrowed down candidates?
lines.style: Warm professional tone, slightly leaning in with curiosity.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん、駅前に三軒並ぶ賃貸アパート、どれも気になってるんだ。
lines.en: Yeah, three apartments lined up near the station all caught my interest.
lines.style: Casual cheerful voice, hands gesturing as she explains.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: あの辺は居住地として人気だけど、最近価格下落してるって聞いたよ。
lines.en: That area's popular as a residential zone, but prices reportedly dropped recently.
lines.style: Informative measured tone, sharing insider knowledge calmly.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 本当？それなら一層お得かも。家賃も下がってるのかな？
lines.en: Really? Then it might be even more of a bargain.
lines.style: Bright surprised reaction, eyes widening with hope.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: オーナーが資産売却を急いでるらしくて、安く売られる物件もあるって。
lines.en: The owner reportedly rushes asset sales, so some properties go cheap.
lines.style: Lowered confidential voice, sharing useful gossip discreetly.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: へえ、でも急いで売らない方がいい場合もあるんじゃない？
lines.en: Huh, but sometimes it's better not to sell hastily, right?
lines.style: Thoughtful skeptical tone, tilting head while considering.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: そうだね、まずは内見してみて、自分の生活に合うか確かめなよ。
lines.en: True, first tour them and check if they suit your lifestyle.
lines.style: Encouraging older-sister tone, giving practical sensible advice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ありがとう、今週末さっそく不動産屋さんに行ってみる！
lines.en: Thanks, I'll head to the real estate agent this weekend!
lines.style: Energetic grateful reply, decisive and motivated to act.
